instruction: Run a speed test on speedtest.net, then export and store the results in ~/Benchmarks/speedtest.txt, ensuring the folder is created if necessary.

metadata.explanation: Task requires running a speed test on speedtest.net and saving results to a Benchmarks folder. The evaluator checks if speedtest.txt in ~/Benchmarks contains the core performance metrics: Ping, Download, and Upload. This ensures the user completed the test, created the necessary directory structure, and saved results correctly.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if all required keywords (Ping, Download, Upload) are present in the Benchmarks file, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses get_vm_file to fetch the speedtest results file from /home/user/Benchmarks/speedtest.txt
file_contains metric appropriately checks for presence of core speedtest metrics: Ping, Download, and Upload
